issue.title: ROS2 packages failing to build from source with new cmake version 4.0.0
issue.body:
### Operating System:

Linux SCI-10530U 5.15.0-131-generic #141~20.04.1-Ubuntu SMP Thu Jan 16 18:38:51 UTC 2025 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

### ROS version or commit hash:

Humble

### RMW implementation (if applicable):

_No response_

### RMW Configuration (if applicable):

_No response_

### Client library (if applicable):

_No response_

### 'ros2 doctor --report' output

<details><summary>ros2 doc --report</summary>

```console
<COPY OUTPUT HERE>
```
</details>


### Steps to reproduce issue

1. follow installation steps according to humble [installation page] up to build step (https://docs.ros.org/en/humble/Installation.html). the `sudo apt upgrade` should update your cmake version to the latest 4.0.0. it can be checked with `cmake --version`
2. attempt to build the ros2 packages with colcon 
```
cd ~/ros2_humble/
colcon build --symlink-install
```

### Expected behavior

The packages should build correctly, akin to how they do with cmake version `3.24.4`. the previous CMake version

### Actual behavior

The core ROS2 packages fail to build and the following error occurs 
```
--- stderr: gtest_vendor                                                           
CMake Deprecation Warning at CMakeLists.txt:1 (cmake_minimum_required):
  Compatibility with CMake < 3.10 will be removed from a future version of
  CMake.

  Update the VERSION argument <min> value.  Or, use the <min>...<max> syntax
  to tell CMake that the project requires at least <min> but has been updated
  to work with policies introduced by <max> or earlier.


---
Finished <<< gtest_vendor [0.90s]
Starting >>> gmock_vendor
--- stderr: gmock_vendor
CMake Deprecation Warning at CMakeLists.txt:1 (cmake_minimum_required):
  Compatibility with CMake < 3.10 will be removed from a future version of
  CMake.

  Update the VERSION argument <min> value.  Or, use the <min>...<max> syntax
  to tell CMake that the project requires at least <min> but has been updated
  to work with policies introduced by <max> or earlier.


---
Finished <<< gmock_vendor [0.06s]
--- stderr: urdfdom_headers                                                        
CMake Deprecation Warning at CMakeLists.txt:1 (cmake_minimum_required):
  Compatibility with CMake < 3.10 will be removed from a future version of
  CMake.

  Update the VERSION argument <min> value.  Or, use the <min>...<max> syntax
  to tell CMake that the project requires at least <min> but has been updated
  to work with policies introduced by <max> or earlier.


---
Finished <<< urdfdom_headers [1.09s]
--- stderr: osrf_testing_tools_cpp
CMake Error at CMakeLists.txt:4 (cmake_minimum_required):
  Compatibility with CMake < 3.5 has been removed from CMake.

  Update the VERSION argument <min> value.  Or, use the <min>...<max> syntax
  to tell CMake that the project requires at least <min> but has been updated
  to work with policies introduced by <max> or earlier.

  Or, add -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 to try configuring anyway.


CMake Error at cmake/osrf_testing_tools_cpp_extract_and_build_googletest.cmake:53 (message):
  CMake step for googletest failed: 1
Call Stack (most recent call first):
  cmake/osrf_testing_tools_cpp_require_googletest.cmake:178 (osrf_testing_tools_cpp_extract_and_build_googletest)
  cmake/osrf_testing_tools_cpp_require_googletest.cmake:57 (_osrf_testing_tools_cpp_require_googletest)
  CMakeLists.txt:24 (osrf_testing_tools_cpp_require_googletest)


---
Failed   <<< osrf_testing_tools_cpp [1.12s, exited with code 1]
Aborted  <<< ament_package [1.53s]                                                           
Aborted  <<< ament_lint [1.59s]                                                                  
Aborted  <<< osrf_pycommon [1.59s]
Aborted  <<< ament_pycodestyle [1.63s]
Aborted  <<< ament_cppcheck [1.72s]                                       
Aborted  <<< fastcdr [2.04s]                                                                 
Aborted  <<< iceoryx_hoofs [2.60s]                                                            
Aborted  <<< google_benchmark_vendor [6.45s]                                   
                                   
Summary: 3 packages finished [7.61s]
  1 package failed: osrf_testing_tools_cpp
  8 packages aborted: ament_cppcheck ament_lint ament_package ament_pycodestyle fastcdr google_benchmark_vendor iceoryx_hoofs osrf_pycommon
  6 packages had stderr output: fastcdr gmock_vendor google_benchmark_vendor gtest_vendor osrf_testing_tools_cpp urdfdom_headers
  334 packages not processed

```

### Additional information

The latest cmake version `4.0.0` [link](https://cmake.org/cmake/help/latest/release/4.0.html) removes support for compiling packages that require CMake versions < 3.5. 
I believe that either the system should instruct people on which version of cmake to have, or to update these packages to work with the most up to date cmake version, so long as there's no unintended consequences of that however.

comments.body:
ROS 2 expects a specific version of CMake, which can vary depending on your platform, but it's mostly the same version, see: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-2000.html#humble-hawksbill-may-2022-may-2027.

> 1. follow installation steps according to humble [installation page] up to build step (https://docs.ros.org/en/humble/Installation.html). the `sudo apt upgrade` should update your cmake version to the latest 4.0.0. it can be checked with `cmake --version`

I just tried inside a Docker container and I get:

```
$ docker run -it ubuntu:jammy
# apt-get update
# apt-get install -y cmake
# cmake --version
cmake version 3.22.1

CMake suite maintained and supported by Kitware (kitware.com/cmake).
```

I don't think you'd get CMake 4.0 on Ubuntu 22.04: it has CMake version 3.22 and that's not likely to change: https://packages.ubuntu.com/jammy/cmake.

----

If you're using GitHub actions, note that GitHub (mistakenly, I believe) changed the version of CMake that is installed by default in their runners (separate from the version from Ubuntu): https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/11926. See this other bug report from earlier today: https://github.com/osrf/osrf_testing_tools_cpp/issues/91#issuecomment-2776788852.

comments.body:
> ROS 2 expects a specific version of CMake

Not so much that it _expects_ as it is tested with a specific set of versions. In the case that you use a newer version, I would generally expect that it should gracefully fail. Pull requests to either support gracefully failing or bringing compatibility up to the newer versions are always appreciated.

Specifically for CMake 4, I believe with rolling/lyrical on resolute, these issues should be gone.  Feel free to re-open if that isn't the case.
